data.long_meaning: The name Babasaheb is a Marathi name that is derived from the words 'Baba' which means father and 'Sahib' which means master or god. This name is often given to a person who is revered as a spiritual or religious leader. The name signifies respect and devotion towards the person. The name Babasaheb carries the meaning “Father of the God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Marathi tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Babasaheb usually hope their child will grow to embody father of the god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
